trap-triples.evidence: "only the small-rank rows ($\lambda \in \{(n), (n-1,1), (n-2,2)\}$) carry non-negligible Frobenius mass at $q_0$" is a reflex three-item set that the blocks this preamble introduces contradict. prop:he4-two-row-dominance (n=12) gives the top block as (9,3) = (n-3,3) at 29.0% and (8,4) = (n-4,4) at 23.6% — 52.6% of the trace sits OUTSIDE the three listed shapes, while (n-2,2) = (10,2) carries only 13.5%. rem:hecke-radical-is-temperley-lieb states the correct rule: every shape with at most two rows survives (weights of >=3-row partitions vanish identically as rational functions of q), which is a stratum, not a triple.
trap-triples.notes: NOT fixed (the claim is mathematical and its correction changes meaning). Proposed fix: "only the two-row shapes ($\ell(\lambda) \le 2$) carry Frobenius mass at $q_0$; the weight of any partition with three or more rows vanishes identically."

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Closes on a forward pointer to the next subsection.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: "This subsection extracts..." / "The blocks cover..." is standard signposting for a prose preamble.

trap-superlative.evidence: "consumes this prediction wholesale" is a register flourish but makes no inflated claim.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: The second paragraph is dense (four clauses each naming a mechanism) but each parses aloud.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: Separate (non-trap) findings: (1) "the $V_{21}$ cosine symmetrisation pins the relative phase of the trivial against the standard 1d-irrep" — V_(2,1) IS the standard representation and it is TWO-dimensional (the block it describes, prop:hoefsmit-V21-cos-symmetrization, gives its 2x2 Hoefsmit matrices explicitly); the 1-d irreps are the trivial and the SIGN. Proposed fix: "...against the sign irrep", or "...the trivial and sign 1-d irreps against the 2-d standard irrep". (2) "the substrate-level magic-shell prediction tabulated against the empirical noble-gas sequence" appears to cross shell systems: the subsection's worked example is doubly-magic 4He, i.e. NUCLEAR magic numbers (2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126), whereas the noble-gas sequence (2, 10, 18, 36, 54, 86) is the ATOMIC closed-shell series. Worth confirming which table is actually produced.
